question: If sin theta=(5)/(13), then what is the value of (cos² theta-sin² theta)/(2cos theta.sin theta)?
solution:
**Given:**

** sin θ=(5)/(13)**

**Concept Used:**

cos θ = √(1 - sin² θ)

**Calculation:**

sin θ = 5/13

⇒ cos θ = √(1 - (5/13)²)

⇒ cos θ = √(169 - 25)/169

⇒ cos θ = √(144/169)

⇒ cos θ = 12/13

Put the values in (cos² theta-sin² theta)/(2cos theta.sin theta)

⇒ ((12/13)² -(5/13)²)/(2times 12/13 times 5/13)

⇒ (119/169)/(120/169)

⇒ 119/120

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
